nodes.label: Strategic Suspense Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Awaiting data before returning JSX blocks the whole layout for data only one subtree needs; a Suspense boundary streams that subtree while sidebar/header/footer paint immediately. A promise started but not awaited can be shared across sibling components via use() so only one fetch occurs. Explicit trade-off: faster initial paint vs layout shift; skip it for layout-deciding data, SEO-critical above-the-fold content, and small fast queries.

edges.source_location: both hold an un-awaited promise (dataPromise / sessionPromise) as the shared handle that defers the await
